title: Preserve incident trace when averaging partially coherent probes and scans
statement: The source uses K(k,kprime)=exp[-2pi^2 sigma_source^2|k-kprime|^2] and the sinusoidal scan characteristic factor with J0. Positive components retain more than1-1e-6 incident trace without renormalizing discarded weight. A9x9position quadrature that matched FWHM but failed high-separation coherence was rejected.

body: These are incoming-site fluence diagnostics,not acquired displacement hazards,retained writing,all-species damage advantage or reset. FWHM alone does not determine the mutual intensity.
